title: borreria poaya var. nervosa
intro: Borreria poaya var. nervosa, commonly known as Nervosine, is a plant species within the Rubiaceae family, traditionally used for its medicinal properties. The plant is valued for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate conditions such as fever and pain. Therapeutically, Borreria poaya var. nervosa is known to exhibit sedative and spasmolytic actions, making it a potential treatment for anxiety and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
